integrity_notes: Complete proof and exact finite enumerative checker supplied. Computational checks corroborate, but do not replace, the general integral-lattice proof.
scientific_limitations: No closed form for nonzero Gram eigenvalues or quantitative lower frame bound. Strictly convex labelled polygon setting. Historical equivalent statements may exist; the complete 2002 flip-graph article was not inspected. Earlier publication information for that paper has only year precision and is not assigned an invented day.
title: Integral Fourier identifiability from noncrossing perfect matchings
